freshness_boundary.permitted_claim: real-system external feasibility/falsification bridge for an A/M subfamily of finite BAM worlds

source.title: Data and code from: A framework for investigating fish population density responses to habitat fragmentation
source.file_ids_checksums_and_exact_sizes: discover and freeze from Dryad API metadata only at Gate0; no data payload access

real_system.design: barrier-stream/reference-stream pairs with sites upstream and downstream of low-head dams or corresponding reference locations
real_system.sampling: most streams have three sites above and three below the barrier, or corresponding locations in the reference stream; fish collected with backpack electrofishing

cohort.rule: after calibration payload opening, include every species with at least two distinct 90s positive physical sites; no species may be selected or removed using 2023 response, published effect sign, model coefficient, or favorable EOG result
cohort.expected_article_scale: 29 modeled species is contextual only and is not an eligibility target
cohort.heldout_zero_positive_species: retain with status no_heldout_positive_witness; do not drop

B_axis.reason: the released dataset does not provide a predeclared causal biotic-interaction variable suitable for a defensible B constraint
B_axis.claim: this bridge validates an A/M subfamily of BAM; it is not evidence that empirical B has been measured

A_axis.global_scaling: using all 90s habitat nodes only, center each field by its median and divide by IQR; zero/nonfinite IQR is terminal_stop
A_axis.distance: L-infinity distance in the seven-field scaled habitat space
A_axis.threshold_population: all unordered pairwise habitat distances among distinct 90s physical nodes
A_axis.species_support_rule: a node-period is A-compatible at threshold q iff its habitat vector lies within q of at least one 90s calibration-positive node for that species
A_axis.response_independence: thresholds/scaling use habitat registry only; species positives enter only as frozen support anchors after all thresholds are fixed

M_axis.graph_nodes: physical nodes keyed by stream, position and segment
M_axis.within_side_edges: undirected edges between consecutive segment numbers within the same stream and same upstream/downstream position
M_axis.cross_reference_location: if barrier=0 for the target period, connect upstream segment 1 and downstream segment 1
barrier_worlds: M_barrier_closed: if barrier=1, no edge crosses between upstream segment 1 and downstream segment 1
M_barrier_open: connect upstream segment 1 and downstream segment 1 regardless of barrier=1
M_axis.open_world: M_open_all uses M_barrier_open with unrestricted graph-step horizon
M_axis.calibration_sources: all 90s positive physical nodes for the focal species

world_product.calibration_compatibility: positive-only containment: every 90s positive physical node must satisfy A and M in the 90s state

heldout_contract.response: 2023 species total_caught > 0 at a physical node
heldout_contract.primary_endpoint: for each species and each 2023 positive node, exact number/fraction of calibration-surviving worlds falsified because A or M excludes that positive
secondary: survivor-fiber contraction from all heldout positives
A-versus-M witness attribution for falsified worlds
species retained with zero heldout positives
whether any species remains nonidentified after complete heldout positive evidence

stages: Gate0 Dryad metadata identity: DOI/title/required file names; freeze file IDs/checksums/exact sizes; zero data bytes
Gate1 README full text only; verify documented schemas and period semantics; zero RDS data bytes
Gate2 freeze RDS parser, exact join keys, A/M constructor, cohort and output schema
Gate3 once-only open both required RDS data payloads; parse complete data; execute calibration then heldout-positive falsification without retuning
hard_stops: do not add a community-derived B constraint after data access
do not select a focal species based on effect or EOG result
do not change A fields or threshold quantiles after RDS access
do not change M horizons, graph edges, or barrier semantics after RDS access
do not promote 2023 nondetection to biological absence
do not call this fresh or independent confirmatory evidence
do not use article aggregate effects as the bridge target
success_definition: successful bridge means a real repeated fish-survey dataset can instantiate a frozen finite A/M world family and later positive observations can either preserve or falsify worlds without post-response retuning; favorable contraction is not required
